players.name: Payton Wilson
players.comment: Wilson recorded just three tackles (one solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: Patrick Queen
players.comment: Queen recorded four total tackles (three solo) during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: Alex Highsmith
players.comment: Highsmith (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Broncos, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: DeShon Elliott
players.comment: Elliott (knee) does not carry an injury designation into Friday's game against the Broncos, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

players.name: Jalen Ramsey
players.comment: Ramsey recorded one solo tackle and a pass defensed during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: Chris Boswell
players.comment: Boswell went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.comment: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.comment: Pittman (foot), who was activated from IR on Thursday, doesn't carry an injury designation for Friday's game against the Broncos, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.comment: Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards on 10 targets in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.comment: Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos and could remain atop the depth chart for the rest of the season with the Steelers waiving Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday.

players.name: Pat Freiermuth
players.comment: Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.

players.name: Alex Singleton
players.comment: Singleton recorded 11 total tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, while also adding a pass defensed during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

players.name: Brandon Jones
players.comment: Jones (hamstring) was listed as a full participant at the Broncos' walkthrough practice Tuesday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official practice reports.

players.name: Ja'Quan McMillian
players.comment: McMillian recorded eight total tackles (four solo), a forced fumble and a pick-six during Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

players.name: Wil Lutz
players.comment: Lutz made his lone field-goal attempt and all five PATs in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

players.name: Courtland Sutton
players.comment: Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.comment: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.

players.name: Bo Nix
players.comment: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.

players.name: Evan Engram
players.comment: Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
